quotes.text: America should lead the world in innovation in new technologies like artificial intelligence and blockchain, while setting responsible guardrails that protect families, workers, and hard-earned savings.
“This is a top concern,” Hines said. “We’re right next to Lake St. Clair. People are very worried about protecting our water.”

“People are already struggling with the high cost of gas and groceries and healthcare. We cannot afford for our bills to keep going up,” Hines said, adding that “we need a strong Congress that is actually going to, you know, engage in sensible regulation to protect the American people.”
“So far we’ve had a Congress that has really failed to put any guardrails up to keep our community safe,” Hines said, noting her excitement to begin working putting those regulations in place.
